analytics.report.get.title: Get Analytics Report
analytics.report.get.description: Fetch a synchronous TikTok Ads integrated report via GET /report/integrated/get/. Requires advertiserId, dataLevel, startDate, and endDate. Send reportType; the request does not apply a BASIC default.

reportType.description: Report type, e.g. BASIC, AUDIENCE, CATALOG (default BASIC).

dataLevel.description: Data level, e.g. AUCTION_CAMPAIGN, AUCTION_ADGROUP, AUCTION_AD, AUCTION_ADVERTISER.

dimensions.description: Optional dimension keys, e.g. campaign_id, stat_time_day.

metrics.description: Optional metric keys, e.g. spend, impressions, clicks.

queryLifetime.description: When true, query lifetime stats instead of date range.

advertisers.list.title: List Advertisers
advertisers.list.description: List advertisers authorized for the Access-Token via GET /oauth2/advertiser/get/. Pass appId and appSecret when TikTok requires them. Known-ID lookup is advertisers.get on /advertiser/info/.

advertiserIds.description: Optional advertiser IDs; when set, calls /advertiser/info/ instead of oauth advertiser get.

appId.description: Optional TikTok app_id (official oauth2/advertiser/get docs list this as required).

appSecret.description: Optional TikTok app secret (official oauth2/advertiser/get docs list this as required).

ad_groups.get.description: Fetch a single TikTok Ads ad group by advertiserId and adGroupId via /adgroup/get/ with adgroup_ids filtering.

ads.get.title: Get Ad
ads.get.description: Fetch a single TikTok Ads ad by advertiserId and adId via /ad/get/ with ad_ids filtering.

pixels.list.title: List Pixels
pixels.list.description: List TikTok pixels for an advertiser via /pixel/list/.
